article.title: Cleveland plays Milwaukee for conference showdown
article.linkText: Cleveland plays Milwaukee for conference showdown
article.story: Cleveland Cavaliers (3-2, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Milwaukee Bucks (1-4, 13th in the Eastern Conference) Milwaukee; Saturday, 8 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Milwaukee plays Cleveland in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams. Milwaukee went 32-50 overall and 21-31 in Eastern Conference games a season ago. The Bucks averaged 25.8 assists per game on 40.8 made field goals last season. Cleveland went 52-30 overall, 11-5 in Central Division action and 25-16 on the road a season ago. The Cavaliers averaged 28.3 assists per game on 43.3 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Bucks: None listed. Cavaliers: Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back), Meleek Thomas: day to day (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
